stem: Priya connects an LED to a dry cell in her school science lab in Jaipur. The LED allows current to flow through it in one direction only. Which connection will make the LED glow?

options.text: Either way of connecting the LED, because it behaves like a small filament bulb
The longer leg of the LED connected to the negative terminal of the cell
The longer leg of the LED connected to the positive terminal of the cell
The LED will glow only if two cells are used, whichever way it is connected

teacher.key_rationale: An LED conducts in one direction only; it glows when its positive terminal (longer leg) is connected to the positive side of the cell. Option A is the trap for a student who drops the stated one-direction condition and treats the LED like an ordinary lamp. B reverses the polarity, and D wrongly adds a voltage condition while ignoring direction.
